{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script (translated from Slurm)

# Slurm requested:
#   --job-name=serene
#   --output=logs/serene.%J.out
#   --error=logs/serene.%J.err
#   --nodes=1
#   --time=24:00:00
#   --gres=gpu:4
#   --gpus-per-node=4
#   --mail-type=ALL
#   --mail-user=mb756@sussex.ac.uk

flux alloc \
  -N 1 \
  -n 1 \
  --gpus=4 \
  --time=24h \
  bash -lc '

mkdir -p logs

# Approximate Slurm %J using Flux job id.
exec >"logs/serene.${FLUX_JOB_ID}.out" 2>"logs/serene.${FLUX_JOB_ID}.err"

# NOTE: Slurm email notifications (--mail-user/--mail-type=ALL) have no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none for runtime, but you will not receive job emails.

# NOTE: Slurm --job-name=serene is not expressed here as a portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none (metadata only), but job identification in monitoring/accounting may be less clear.

module load python/3.8.6
module load cuda/10.1
module load tensorflow/2.3.1

CONFIG_PATH="$HOME/SegU-Net/config"

source "$HOME/nnevn/bin/activate"
python segUNet.py "$CONFIG_PATH/net_Unet_lc.ini"

deactivate
'
"
}
